name: us-bsa-aml-2026
display_name: US Federal BSA / AML — FinCEN, USA PATRIOT Act, AML Act 2020, CTA (narrowed 2025)
description: Structured knowledge graph for the US Federal AML framework: Bank Secrecy Act (31 USC §§5311-5336); USA PATRIOT Act 2001 Title III (CIP §326, §314(a)/(b) info-sharing, §312 correspondent + private-banking EDD, §313 shell-bank prohibition); Anti-Money Laundering Act 2020 (NDAA 2021 Title LXIV) with the SARs reform + AML whistleblower programme + national AML/CFT priorities mandate; FinCEN Corporate Transparency Act framework — substantially narrowed by the March 2025 Interim Final Rule (US domestic reporting companies + US-person beneficial owners now essentially exempt; only FOREIGN reporting companies + foreign-individual BOs in scope); 31 CFR Chapter X operational FinCEN regulations (incl. CDD Rule 1010.230 + CIP Rule 1020.220); FFIEC BSA/AML Examination Manual; FinCEN's 8 AML/CFT National Priorities (June 2021); plus federal supervisor interplay (OCC + Federal Reserve + FDIC + NCUA + SEC + CFTC + IRS-CI).
author: Futurechain FCP Team
regulation_ids: Corporate Transparency Act 2020 — narrowed by FinCEN IFR (March 2025)
Beneficial Ownership Information Reporting Rule (FinCEN, Sept 2022; narrowed March 2025)
